## Context

We need stateless session validation across multiple service instances.

## Decision

Issue signed JWTs with a 12h TTL. Sign with HS256 using a shared secret
rotated quarterly.

## Consequences

No central session store. Revocation requires a small blacklist for the
TTL window.
